explore.description: Discover the detailed analysis behind this result
explore.placeholder: Ask a question about the data or sources...

refine.description: Shape your content through iterative instructions
refine.placeholder: How would you like to change this content?
refine.placeholderFollowUp: What else would you like to change?
refine.emptyState: Type an instruction below to start refining your content.
refine.iterationWarning: {count} iterations — consider accepting or starting fresh.
refine.outOfScopeMessage: I can only edit what's already in the current text. To add new information, either paste it here and ask again, or use the Explore tab to pull it from elsewhere in your workflow.
refine.errorEmptyResponse: The refinement returned no content. Try rephrasing your instruction.
refine.errorInstructionTooLong: Instruction is too long ({length} chars). Maximum is {max}.
refine.errorContentTooLong: Content is too long ({length} chars). Maximum is {max}.
refine.errorCombinedTooLong: Combined size of content, instruction, and history is too large ({length} chars). Maximum is {max}.

presets.helpText: Presets are saved instructions you can reuse with one click. Press + to create one. Give it a name and the instruction to apply. Presets appear here as buttons.
presets.createDescription: Create a reusable refinement instruction you can apply with one click.
presets.createInstructionPlaceholder: e.g. Rewrite for a senior executive audience. Use concise language, lead with conclusions, and highlight key risks.
presets.editDescription: Update the name or instruction for this preset.
presets.deleteDescription: Are you sure you want to delete this preset? This cannot be undone.
